name: 002-random-clock
description: Locks the two sources of nondeterminism the engine is allowed to have. The transcript records 1000 raw draws, the float derivation, an int() histogram, and a weightedPick distribution snapshot; state.json records where every stream and the clock stopped. A change to the seed hash, the mulberry32 constants, the fork derivation, int()'s rejection window, or the UTC calendar arithmetic fails here — and fails visibly, at the draw that first diverged. Streams are addressed relative to the probe module's own stream, so the recorded paths also pin the per-module fork the reducer performs. It shares the fixture cartridge with 001, so the clock starts where that world says it does.
